title: VS Code Extension Developer Leads Input

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Marketplace search terms, e.g. database, kubernetes, ai assistant. Each keyword is searched separately and results are merged per publisher.

categories.title: Marketplace categories (optional)
categories.description: Official category names, e.g. AI, Programming Languages, Data Science, Themes, Testing, Linters. Combined with keywords.

minInstalls.title: Minimum total installs per publisher
minInstalls.description: Only publishers whose matched extensions total at least this many installs. Use 10000+ to target established companies.

maxPublishers.title: Max publishers per run
maxPublishers.description: Cap on publisher lead rows returned. Controls total cost.

includeEmail.title: Scrape publisher websites for contact emails
includeEmail.description: Fetch each publisher's website and extract public contact emails. Turn off for a faster, cheaper directory-only run.

maxEmailLookups.title: Max website email lookups
maxEmailLookups.description: Cap on publisher websites fetched for email extraction.

dedupe.title: Skip publishers seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned publishers across runs and skip them. Turn on for scheduled prospecting.
